input_boundary: Only the scrubbed OIC-v1 public-input artifact is loaded. The original authored fixture file is outside this experiment's runtime inputs.
evaluation_rule: Invariant cases require input change, exact normalized-contract equality, and raw grounding in transformed identifiers with no stale-value leakage. Sensitivity cases require an exact fail-closed execution projection, including blocked gate, no permitted action, family-specific next action, and exact state preservation.
analysis_unit: One base fixture is the primary task-level reporting unit; transformed cases are paired within-fixture deterministic repeated measures.
coverage_gate: The frozen 28-task, 5/5/3 apply, 112-invariant, 55-sensitivity, and family-by-relation profiles must all be exact and non-vacuous.
